newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX to move Henry Hub gas futures expiry forward.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX to move Henry Hub gas futures expiry forward.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange said Thursday it approved last week moving the expiration date of its Henry Hub natural gas futures contract forward to the third to last business day of the month.
Currently, Henry Hub futures expire on the fifth to last business day of the month.
NYMEX said the expiration of corresponding options would be moved to the business day immediately before the futures expiry.
The changes must be approved by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC).
The new expiration dates would conform with the expirations of the newly introduced Permian and Alberta natural gas futures and options contracts.
